div.div: 5 تفهّر فِى المَالِ He became, or made himself, ample, or abundant, in wealth, or in camels, or the like; (S, O, K;) as also ↓ تَفَيْهَرَ ; (K;) as though the former verb were formed by substitution from تَبَحَّرَ: or it may mean he was, or became, weary, fatigued, or jaded, and languid, or remiss. (S, O.) And تفهّر فِى الكَلَامِ He took a wide, or an ample, range in speech. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
